owner_creation.analysis: The BUFFER_ALLOCATION_FAILED AtomicBool owns a process failure latch for the first empty-cache allocation failure; it holds no buf pointer or allocation extent.
owner_creation.invariant: The latch is initialized without creating a buffer owner.
limitations: BUFFER_ALLOCATION_FAILED owns one suppression latch, not a cache node.

aliases_escapes.analysis: buffer_allocation_failed exports a Boolean; ch_get checks BUFFER_ALLOCATION_FAILED before touching cache state and records it when only the list sentinel remains.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A failure value cannot alias an input buffer.
limitations: The sentinel guard, rather than this atomic alone, protects cache payload access.

callback_targets.analysis: The first failed transition calls a fixed diagnostic directly; no indirect target or allocator callback is retained by the BUFFER_ALLOCATION_FAILED flag.
callback_targets.invariant: Allocation failure reporting stores no callable state.
limitations: Diagnostic emission is direct and does not transfer buffer ownership to the latch.

invalidation.analysis: BUFFER_ALLOCATION_FAILED remains set even after navigation or buffer changes; failed first allocation is not hidden by a later state replacement.
invalidation.invariant: Failure state survives changes of active input.

mutation_commit.analysis: The empty-list guard sets the BUFFER_ALLOCATION_FAILED bit before returning -1 and avoids casting the sentinel to buf; later ch_get calls short-circuit.
mutation_commit.invariant: No absent buffer payload is published as initialized.

release_pair.analysis: This BUFFER_ALLOCATION_FAILED Boolean requires no free; the absence of a new allocation leaves buffer/list owners unchanged and no payload needs releasing.
release_pair.invariant: Allocation failure creates no latch-owned heap object.
limitations: The Boolean has no allocator counterpart even when first-buffer allocation fails.

error_cleanup.analysis: After BUFFER_ALLOCATION_FAILED is set, ch_get returns -1 without casting the sentinel to a buf. The initialized filestate stays attached until normal close/permanent disposal; the Boolean itself needs no release.
error_cleanup.invariant: Error observation cannot count as finding resolution.

signals_handoff.analysis: The BUFFER_ALLOCATION_FAILED atomic latch tolerates concurrent value access, but it grants no right to mutate the surrounding filestate during a handler.
signals_handoff.invariant: Atomic failure state does not protect cache pointers.
limitations: This reviews the current guard/latch; IND-MEM-FIRSTBUF remains open pending the maintained closure process.
